territories.name: Guyana
territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and a State outside it is a third country for every rule the Directive carries. Guyana levies a value-added tax of its own under the Value-Added Tax Act 2005 (Act No. 10 of 2005), administered by the Guyana Revenue Authority: section 9 imposes it on the taxable supply in Guyana of goods or services by a taxable person and on goods and services imported, at the single rate the Regulations fix at 14 per cent, with a zero rate for the supplies of Schedule I and exemption for those of Schedule II.
